Name: HeartForge's Long-Haired Seasonal Sam Portraits
Author: HeartForge
Description:
Tired of Broom-Head Sam? Want more long-haired men in your game? Love the vanilla Art style? Hopefully this will do it for you.

I decided to release this a bit earlier than intended, A lot has come up in life so I haven't been able to do all I've wanted with sam.

Future plans include:
Sprites
Minor edits and some necessary, Or maybe unnecessary, fixes
Custom spirits eve outfit(s?)
Generally more expressions and visual changes (Outfits and other features) to go along with my future coming mods.

Possible plans:
Piercings, Gingerbelley set and custom options
Vanilla-like, Less Natural blonde color hair for those who may want it back
Natural blonde color for kent additional download (Planning to redo kent, and, everyone really, in the far and distant future, anyway, however.)


[b][u]*This mod does nothing on its own.[/u][/b]
I made this for personal use, intended to be used with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], But it will definitely work with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20608]Seasonal Sam with a Mullet[/url], Or its unseasonal counterpart, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19330]Sam Mullet Replacement[/url]﻿ until I get his sprites made, if it bothers you, But there may be some sudden differences between portrait and sprite.

Just replace sam's portrait files with these.

Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Gingerbelley?gameId=1303]Gingerbelley[/url] for permission to use their style of Sam's beautiful hair! Go check out their portraits for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31442?tab=description]Sam's HD style.[/url]

Downloads.Description: Seasonal Long Haired Sam. _Fall is his default outfit, If you do not use seasonal sprites. Includes extra hatless portraits because why not. Just need to be renamed.
